title: La denuncia
goal: Report a stolen phone and manage your expectations
culture: You will get a piece of paper, not the phone. The paper is for the phone company. Asking the officer whether it is worth anything is a completely normal question and he will answer it honestly, which is worth more than the paper.

beats.good: Me robaron — they robbed me, with no particular they. Spanish puts it this way round and it is the normal way to say it.
Anoche is last night in one word. Where matters more than you would think — he already knows which corner.

beats.objective: Say you want to file it
beats.en: I want to file a report.
beats.good: Poner una denuncia — to file a report. The verb is poner, which is worth knowing before you are standing at the desk.

beats.es: Le doy el papel. Pero el teléfono ya no aparece, se lo digo de una vez.
beats.objective: Ask whether it is worth anything
beats.good: Ask it. He will tell you the truth — the paper is for the phone company, not for getting the phone back — and you are both better for the honesty.
